claim: The World's 50 Best March 2026 Athens guide picks Kosta and Lefteris o Politis for street food, O Lolos in Koukaki for taverna, Delta and Soil for fine dining, Baba au Rum for cocktails.
quote: pockets of pillowy pita, filled with seared pork or beef, seasoned tomato and French fries

claim: Michelin expands its Greek coverage in 2026 to Santorini and Thessaloniki alongside an updated Athens selection, revealed in the second half of 2026.
quote: For the first time, the Guide will fully evaluate Thessaloniki and Santorini, alongside an updated selection for Athens

claim: Athens' official city guide lists Delta (2 stars, Kallithea) plus one-star Soil, The Zillers, Pelagos, CTC, Spondi and Botrini's, with tasting menus around EUR 95-180.
quote: excellent form and quality ... reasonably priced by international standards

claim: Kostas in Plaka sells pork souvlaki at EUR 3.50, cash only, closing when the meat runs out; O Thanasis (Monastiraki, since 1964) does kebab and Elvis in Psyrri serves until the small hours.
quote: At €3.50 for pork souvlaki, it's cash only and closes by 3-4 PM when the meat runs out.

claim: Koukaki taverna dinners run EUR 15-25 per person, roughly 30% below Plaka; Exarchia full meals EUR 8-12; Kolonaki fine dining EUR 30-50+.
quote: Dinner €15-25/person; pricing runs 30% lower than Plaka.

claim: Varvakios Agora on Athinas Street, open since 1886, runs Mon-Sat 07:00-18:00 with 100+ butcher stalls and 150 fish stalls plus cheap cook-house tavernas inside.
quote: over 100 butcher stalls, 150 fish stalls, 80 fruit-and-vegetable stands

claim: Athens rooftop cocktails run EUR 14-18 (up to EUR 22 at GB Roof Garden); A for Athens charges EUR 12-15 and 360 Cocktail Bar EUR 10-13, with Acropolis-facing tables filling an hour before sunset.
quote: either worth every cent or a hostage situation with a view

claim: Tipping in Greece means rounding up or adding 5-10%, 10-15% at upscale venues, and cash is the norm.
quote: rounding up the bill or adding 5-10% is standard

claim: Sifnos is the Cyclades' food capital: clay-pot revithada, the birthplace of cookbook author Nikolaos Tselementes, and the highest concentration of chefs per capita in Greece.
quote: The slow-cooked revithada (chickpea stew in unglazed clay pots) alone is worth the ferry ticket.

claim: Naxos is the produce island: small creamy potatoes and aged local graviera.
quote: Naxos potatoes are legitimately famous — small, creamy, and completely different from supermarket potatoes

claim: Santorini's signature is domatokeftedes (tomato fritters); Naxos is known for graviera, ximomizithra and kopanisti.
quote: Domatokeftedes, tomato-fried balls, are very popular on the island of Santorini.

claim: Travel.gr's December 2025 Athens list spreads the serious kitchens across Pangrati (Akra, Seeds, Ex Machina), Petralona (Herve), Koukaki (Gallina) and Kolonaki (Simul, Iodio), with CTC in Kerameikos serving an 11-course blind tasting.
Delta is Greece's only two-Michelin-star restaurant and holds a Green Star.
quote: Delta Restaurant - (2) Michelin Star restaurant in Athens

claim: Delta sits inside the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center in Kallithea, on the fifth floor of the Greek National Opera building.
quote: The restaurant is located inside the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Centre (SNFCC)
